summary.ko: 원본을 보존하며 형식·결측·중복·값 범위를 점검하고 변환 이력을 남깁니다.
summary.en: Clean tabular data reproducibly while preserving originals and documenting every transformation.

required_inputs.description: Authorized tabular data and field definitions if available
Intended use, known valid ranges, identifiers, and normalization requirements

workflow.instruction: Profile types, missing values, duplicates, formats, ranges, and unexpected category values before changing records.
Define explicit transformation rules and distinguish mechanical normalization from business decisions.
Apply safe transformations to a separate output, preserving identifiers and flagging ambiguous records rather than deleting them silently.
Reconcile input and output row counts, calculate validation checks, and produce a transformation log with unresolved exceptions.

deliverables.name: Cleaned dataset
deliverables.acceptance_criteria: Preserves source meaning and identifies unresolved records

deliverables.name: Data quality report
deliverables.acceptance_criteria: Includes checks, counts, transformation rules, and unresolved exceptions

limitations: Do not infer missing values or deduplicate entities without a defensible rule.
permission_boundaries: Do not overwrite originals, delete records, query production systems, or upload data externally without authorization.
Minimize sensitive fields and do not use data to infer protected personal attributes.
